name: Pacific Lamprey Fund (Mitigation and Enhancement Fund)
summary: Hydro-licence mitigation fund for Pacific lamprey in the Lower Deschutes Basin, Oregon, paying for passage and barrier removal, in-stream habitat work, translocation and propagation. A separate research fund sits beside it.
reporting: Awardees submit annual progress reports on work completed, status of ongoing projects and expenditures.

eligibility.rule: Project work is not in streams considered ephemeral
No film, education and outreach materials, first aid kits, or signage costs
Located where Pacific lamprey currently or historically existed within the lower Deschutes River basin
The proposed project is not required by a local, state, tribal or federal agency directive

Agreement with fiscal agent, if applicable

eligibility.quote: The fund dollars will not be distributed for work in streams considered ephemeral.
The Lamprey M&E Fund will not pay for film, education and outreach materials, first aid kits, or signage.

eligible projects for the Lamprey Research Fund must be located where Pacific lamprey currently exist or historically existed within the lower Deschutes River basin from the confluence with the Columbia River upstream to the project and tributaries to historic distribution barriers (Figure 2).
the proposed Resource Project is not required by a local, state, tribal or federal agency directive
